run_profiler_context: run the maybe_run_profiler context manager to profile a PyTorch module with memory snapshots and trace collection
convert_perfetto_to_html: convert a perfetto JSON trace file to an interactive HTML viewer using the perfetto_to_html function
create_profiler_args: create a ProfilerArgs dataclass to configure warmup steps, profile steps, and trace folder for profiling
use_pytorch_profiler_wandb: use PyTorchProfilerWandb to profile CUDA operations and log trace HTML reports to Weights and Biases
use_mem_snapshot_profiler_wandb: use MemSnapshotsProfilerWandb to capture memory snapshots and log memory trace plots to Weights and Biases
